reasoning: The icon combines a standard clipboard outline with an unexplained 'm' glyph in the lower-right corner. Because a single letter modifier on a clipboard has no universal visual meaning, users scanning a task list cannot reliably tell whether it means Markdown, Medium, macro, or just a generic clipboard.
